title: The Concept of Cognitive Dissonance
text:
Cognitive dissonance describes the mental discomfort experienced by a person who holds two or more contradictory beliefs, ideas, or values. This internal conflict often motivates individuals to change one of the conflicting cognitions or introduce new beliefs that justify the behavior, thereby restoring psychological equilibrium.

Resolution strategies range from minimizing exposure to contradictory information (selective avoidance) to actively altering behavioral patterns. Understanding this mechanism provides insight into how much rationalization can occur in favor of maintaining a self-consistent self-image.
